issues_in: Minor: NOTES.md 2026-08-11 section describes 'verified: true for listed official/public-source facts; verified: false for final permit/construction/energization/capacity', but data.json does not encode the verified field.
fixed: Added top-level "verified": true to data.json encoding the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 convention: listed official/public-source facts (NMED public-notices, OPF docket AQB 26-57(P), BLM ePlanning, NM State Land Office, Oracle/KNW/KVIA reporting) are verified true, while final air permit, county building/site permit, construction, energization, and capacity remain unverified (false) because no confirming record was located by the 2026-08-11 cutoff.

Added "verification_notes" field alongside "verified" documenting the split, matching the sibling convention (e.g. dc/usdc-0117-njfx-high-density-ai-data-hall uses top-level verified boolean + verification_notes).
remaining_risks: No URL issues were flagged for this center; no URLs were re-checked.

The verified flag is a single top-level boolean; per-fact nuance (true for sourced facts, false for permit/construction/energization/capacity) is carried in verification_notes, consistent with the NOTES.md convention.
The inventory issue string is truncated (ends at 'but data'); the fix assumes the intended meaning is that data.json lacks/does not encode the verified field.
summary: Fixed the single minor issue for USDC-0119: data.json now encodes the NOTES.md verified convention via top-level "verified": true plus verification_notes stating that official/public-source facts are verified while final permit/construction/energization/capacity are not (no confirming record located). data.json re-validated as valid JSON; only data.json was edited within the center directory.
